entities.title: Rampart
entities.summary: An original isometric fortress-run shooter in Godot 4 for the browser: fly through a fortress at the right altitude, shoot fuel tanks to stay airborne, cross open space and destroy the Warden at the citadel.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the Godot project in godot/ (procedural models, shaders and synthesised sound, no binary assets), the page around it in web/, the Worker that serves it behind icelander.net's sign-in in worker/, and the tests in test/ and scripts/smoke.sh. It is one npm project and one Cloudflare Worker.
boundaries: No API and no database: the high score is kept in the player's browser (Godot's user://).
The sign-in is icelander.net's; the Worker checks it with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/, never edited here.
The games page's listing of Rampart lives in the icelander.net repository (site/games.json).
